newsitem.title: UK: UK bookmakers cut odds on April election.
newsitem.headline: UK bookmakers cut odds on April election.

text.p: British bookmakers William Hill said they have cut the odds on the next election taking place in April to 11-8 from 6-4.
May remains favourite at 10-11. March is offered at 4-1, February 12-1 and January 66-1. The election must be called by May 22.

Newspapers speculated Prime Minister John Major may call the election in April to take advantage of students being at home rather than at college in certain key constituencies. It is believed most students will vote for the Labour opposition.
